title: It's ok but smaller than pictured.
text: It's ok but smaller than pictured.. It's okay but it's not as tall as it looks on picture and also sometimes the cottonswabs get stuck at the opening and won't come out, I'm not sure if there's some way to avoid this but it seems the fewer there are in the box the easier it is for them to get stuck. Honestly it's more convenient than the normal box they come on but it's not the best dispenser I've found so far so 3/5 stars for me. It looks pretty though.
